boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten no-admission campus cultural stops for an under-21-safe outing at University Park.

cards.title: Walk the Palmer Museum galleries
cards.subtitle: Palmer Museum of Art · University Park campus
cards.notes: Meet at the museum entrance, check in at the front desk, then move through the galleries together at your own pace.
cards.short_summary: A free museum stop beside the Arboretum with gallery space for a low-key group visit.
cards.evidence_claim: The Palmer Museum states that admission is free and no prior reservation is required.
cards.source_title: Palmer Museum of Art — Visitor Information
cards.access_notes: Open Wednesday–Sunday; check the museum page before going. Visitors check in at the front desk; no reservation is required.

cards.entity_name: Earth and Mineral Sciences Museum & Art Gallery
cards.title: Browse fossils and mineral-industry art
cards.subtitle: Earth and Mineral Sciences Museum & Art Gallery · Deike Building
cards.notes: Start on Deike Building’s ground floor, pick a few exhibits to discuss, and use the benches for a relaxed shared stop.
cards.short_summary: A free, public geology-and-art gallery where photography and sketching are encouraged.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum says its University Park exhibition gallery is open to everyone and always free of charge.
cards.access_notes: Located on the Deike Building ground floor; normal hours are Monday–Friday, 10 a.m.–4 p.m.

cards.title: Take a garden walk at the Arboretum
cards.subtitle: The Arboretum at Penn State · beside University Park campus
cards.notes: Choose a loop through the gardens and natural areas, pause at the overlooks, and keep the outing within dawn-to-dusk access.
cards.short_summary: A 370-acre garden and natural-space walk with free daily admission.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State Outreach states that the Arboretum is open every day from dawn until dusk and admission is free.
cards.source_title: Penn State Outreach — The Arboretum at Penn State
cards.access_notes: Open daily from dawn until dusk; stay on established paths and observe posted garden guidance.

cards.title: See the current HUB Gallery show
cards.subtitle: HUB Gallery · HUB-Robeson Center, University Park
cards.notes: Meet inside the HUB-Robeson Center, view the current installation together, and use the gallery’s posted schedule for timing.
cards.short_summary: A daily public art-gallery stop in the student union.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State says the HUB Gallery is open daily from 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. and admission is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Penn State News — HUB-Robeson Galleries present 'Feral Botanica'
cards.access_notes: The cited exhibition is listed through October 31, 2026; gallery hours are 10 a.m.–6 p.m. daily.

cards.title: Visit the Special Collections exhibition
cards.subtitle: Eberly Family Special Collections Library · 104 Paterno Library
cards.notes: Head to room 104, browse the exhibition cases together, and leave time to compare one item each that caught your eye.
cards.short_summary: A free public exhibition in Paterno Library centered on rare and unique materials.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State states that the Special Collections exhibition in 104 Paterno Library is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Penn State News — Special Collections Library exhibition
cards.access_notes: The cited exhibition runs through May 13, 2026; verify a current exhibition and library access before visiting.

cards.title: Look through Penn State sports history
cards.subtitle: All-Sports Museum · adjacent to Beaver Stadium
cards.notes: Plan a museum stop with friends, move through the memorabilia displays, and check the museum’s current visitor information before travel.
cards.short_summary: A campus museum focused on Penn State athletics history and memorabilia.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State Sustainability states that all University museums and cultural sites have free public access and identifies the All-Sports Museum as a University Park museum.
cards.access_notes: Free public access is stated by Penn State; confirm current museum hours before visiting.

cards.title: Explore the historic Armsby Calorimeter
cards.subtitle: Armsby Respiration Calorimeter Museum · University Park campus
cards.notes: Coordinate a visit around current museum availability, then take time to examine the historic scientific apparatus and interpretive material.
cards.short_summary: A historic-science museum stop centered on the Armsby calorimeter.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State identifies the Armsby Respiration Calorimeter Museum as a University Park museum and states that all University museums and cultural sites have free public access.
cards.access_notes: Free public access is stated by Penn State; confirm current museum access and hours in advance.

cards.title: Examine insect collections at Frost
cards.subtitle: Frost Entomological Museum · University Park campus
cards.notes: Check visitor availability first, then browse the insect displays as a group and use labels as prompts for a quick scavenger hunt.
cards.short_summary: A University Park museum devoted to entomological collections.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State identifies the Frost Entomological Museum as a University Park museum and states that all University museums and cultural sites have free public access.
cards.access_notes: Free public access is stated by Penn State; verify current visitor hours and entry details before going.

cards.title: Browse anthropology displays at Matson
cards.subtitle: Matson Museum of Anthropology · University Park campus
cards.notes: Verify the museum’s current access details, then walk the displays together and choose one object to discuss before leaving.
cards.short_summary: A campus museum visit for viewing anthropology collections and exhibits.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State identifies the Matson Museum of Anthropology as a University Park museum and states that all University museums and cultural sites have free public access.
cards.access_notes: Free public access is stated by Penn State; check current museum visitor information before visiting.

cards.title: Visit the PAC Herbarium
cards.subtitle: PAC Herbarium · University Park campus
cards.notes: Check current visitor options, then explore herbarium materials with a friend and connect what you see to a nearby Arboretum walk.
cards.short_summary: A University Park cultural-site stop built around preserved plant collections.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State identifies the PAC Herbarium as a University Park museum and states that all University museums and cultural sites have free public access.
cards.access_notes: Free public access is stated by Penn State; verify current visitor access and hours before making the trip.
